# KAMBO Jewelry

> KAMBO Jewelry is a jewelry workshop in {{CITY}}, Türkiye. We design and handcraft custom jewelry in 925 sterling silver, 14K/18K gold and diamonds, set with natural gemstones, and ship worldwide. Custom orders: idea or sketch → drawing and fixed quote → handmade production ({{PRODUCTION_DAYS}} business days) → photos for approval → insured worldwide shipping.

Known for handmade men's gemstone rings (ruby, sapphire, emerald, aquamarine, lapis lazuli, agate/aqeeq, turquoise, hematite and more), Ottoman-inspired and vintage designs, and engraving of names, dates and Arabic/Ottoman calligraphy. We state whether each stone is natural, treated or lab-created. Silver is solid 925 sterling, stamped 925.
